:::{#headingtop}


I'm a lecturer in bioinformatics at the University of Hong Kong. I teach fundamental biostatistics, bioinformatics, and machine learning courses. 

My research focus on translatiing healthcare problems into quantifiable measurement and actions. I have a wide range capability in psychometrics, statistical machine learning, language processing and network science. Given these tools, I try to find the best modeling method to address the healthcare context.

:::
